title: Novel Morphology of Vertically Aligned Polyacetylene Film
abstract: Abstract                Liquid crystal polymerization method was modified in order to prepare a vertically aligned polyacetylene film. As a result, a film with a very curious morphology was formed. The film was composed of two layers. The layer on the solvent side was a vertically oriented fibril structure, whereas the layer on the acetylene gas side was a randomly oriented fibril structure. The modified method is a very promising one for visualizing the polymer growth process, and the present work clearly demonstrates that a polyacetylene chain grows in the liquid crystal solvent.
